help: Windows 3.1 + Win CD edition, tools/dosbox_tmwin.conf, states in extracted/captures/savestates,
1990 DOS edition (SST.EXE), tools/dosbox_tmdos.conf. C: = extracted/dos_c (a writable COPY of
TM-DOS, game in C:\TM), states in extracted/captures/dos/savestates,
USERS.DAT = extracted/dos_c/TM/USERS.DAT. Start options --machine (default ega; tandy, cga,
hercules, mcga, vgaonly, svga_s3 ...), --args for SST.EXE, e.g. "-E" (EGA), "-T" (Tandy),
The 1990 game drops shifted keys (shift+a types nothing); type names in lower case, the
game capitalises the first letter itself.
dos.missing_hint: copy TM-DOS\* there first (never mount TM-DOS itself)
